definitions.explanation: The community of people one interacts with; the general public and its opinions.

examples.japanese: {世間|せけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧⟦もの→もの：02259_mono⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.notes: Common expression when unexpectedly meeting someone

examples.japanese: {世間|せけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にし→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧⟦すぎる→すぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
examples.english: You worry too much about what others think.
I was told I don't know the ways of the world.

notes:
{世間|せけん} refers to society as experienced personally, emphasizing social perception and opinion.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {世間|せけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧ (It's a small world)
- {世間|せけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (public eye, what people think)
- ⟦{世間|せけん}{体|てい}→世間体：09157_sekentei⟧ (keeping up appearances)
- ⟦{世間|せけん}{話|ばなし}→世間話：07021_sekenbanashi⟧ (small talk, gossip)
- ⟦{世間|せけん}{知|し}らず→世間知らず：22674_sekenshirazu⟧ (naïve, ignorant of the world)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {世間|せけん}: society (personal sphere, social judgment)
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧: society (formal, institutional)
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧: world (global, physical world)
